prompt:
Character reference sheet, one wide image in two parts, photorealistic photograph. LEFT two-thirds: full-body turnaround of the same person, three views side by side at identical scale: front view, exact 90-degree side view, exact 180-degree back view, relaxed A-pose. RIGHT third: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME person facing camera, mouth closed. Plain light-grey background, soft even studio light at a neutral white balance, no shadows, natural skin texture with pores, no text, no labels, no watermark.
The person: 张翠梅, a fictional 55-year-old, Si Nian's adoptive mother and Si Xin's wife.; the face, skin and build of exactly that age, which the role does not change. Appearance: Woman of 55 with a round face, high cheekbones and thin, sharply drawn brows. Her narrow eyes have crow's feet and her lips are thin and downturned. Her chin-length black hair is in a tight 1980s perm. She is of average build, solid, and about 158 cm tall. She wears small gold stud earrings and a jade bangle on her right wrist.. Wearing one outfit only: Plum-purple knitted long-sleeved cardigan buttoned over a plain black high-neck blouse, straight black trousers and black low-heeled leather shoes. She wears a black mourning armband on her left sleeve, gold stud earrings and a jade bangle.. Signature colour: purple. Expression in the close-up shows: Sharp, snobbish and impatient. She fusses over appearances and family face, smothers her biological daughter with affection and is openly scornful of the adopted daughter she drove to despair..
The outfit is identical in every view and in the close-up: the same garments, accessories and details on the same side of the body, seen from that view's angle (an earring on the left ear stays on the left ear; a tie, a pocket square, gloves or hair ribbons are in every view or in none). Garments are plain, with no logo, brand mark, or printed letters or numbers.
Revision notes: The jade bangle must be on her RIGHT wrist (the wearer's right) in every view, not the left. Keep the face, perm, plum-purple cardigan, black high-neck blouse, black armband on the left sleeve, gold studs and everything else as in v1.
Avoid: a different face between the views, an older-looking or younger-looking face than 55, doll-like face, a second outfit, extra people, extra limbs, text or labels.
